title: Double Tour
text: If you appreciate a guide and a driver you cannot do any better.  We were led on a double tour; Montserrat and Barcelona at our pace.  The guide was as they say today interactive!  Carlos and Moyses! Learned about the city from its start with the Romans!
author: James_B

title: Excellent Tour of Montserat and Gaudi church grounds
text: This tour was exactly what we were looking for. Driver Angel was very good on the windy roads to Monserrat and Cristina was an excellent guide with so much information about history and all the beautiful sites we went to. Cristina found the perfect Tappas with Payila that was delicious. It was a wonderful day!
author: Michele_C

title: Private tour Fantastic made to order
text:
Pedro our driver was very accommodating and allowed us to spend more time in Montserrat.
We had already toured most of the city on previous day - this allowed us more time in Montserrat.   Very interesting location and we were able to return to the city by an alternate route to view more of the area.  Great Tour!
author: Theresa_L

title: Barcelona
text: We loved Pedro our driver. He was so knowledgeable and didn't have a time limit on most places we stopped. We stayed about 9 hours and saw everything. Loved Barcelona. Would recommend to anyone.
author: Ruby_C

title: Phenomenal
text: Our tour guide Pedro was phenomenal. He was very knowledgeable and his recommendations on places to eat were outstanding.
author: Denville_M

title: Great one day tour of Monserrat and Barcelona
text: This is a perfect great tour of Barcelona and Monserrat if this is your first time visiting. Pedro did a great job of not only bringing us around to places that are popular with tourists but also to other historical places that are a must and not often visited.  He speaks English very well. He took the time to give a brief history of all the areas we visited. Kudos to Pedro and his company.
author: FELIX_D

title: Excellent tour of Barcelona
text: We very much enjoyed our tour thanks to Pedro, our tour guide. He was very informative and accommodating. I would highly recommend this tour!
author: Margaret M

title: Fabulous Barcelona Experience with J&G Elegance Cars
text: We had a two day layover before heading out on a cruise.  Booked J&G not only for the 8 hour Barcelona tour but also for our airport transfers.  What a wonderful group of people to work with - first with Reme on scheduling the services and then the actual tour with Pedro.  He is very knowledgeable and we were able to make the most of the day visiting many places and having a great meal.  If you are limited on time - J&G is definitely the way to go!! Muchas Gracias!!!
author: antonioi325

title: Enjoyable mountain and city tour in Barcelona.
text: Responsible and experience guide makes our trip fruitful. Good planning and time management make us see the most of Barcelona.
author: Rienna W

title: Super day @ Barcelona and Montserrat
text:
We spent a super day with Pedro our guide. Great guide, great car, great city and a amazing lunch.

Thank you Again for taking care of us.
author: cmgss
